adopt: Serve a transparent 1920x1080 Browser Source overlay on localhost, control OBS scenes and privacy shield over OBS WebSocket v5, and record timestamped focus and highlight markers into a post-stream recap.
description:
Kind: tool

Problem
Live-streaming a coding or agent session splits state across OBS scenes, a YouTube stream dashboard, a music player and a Discord voice room. Switching scenes, triggering a privacy shield, showing the current task and track, or clipping a highlight all become manual clicks that interrupt the work.

Install
not on PyPI yet (pending publish); builds in-tree
synopsis: Dual-stream producer for YouTube Live and Discord Voice with OBS control and a live 1080p Browser Source HUD.
